caption:
The mountain bike trails here don't ask for speed; they ask for a steady rhythm. When the gravel turns steep and the forest closes in, the only thing that matters is the next pedal stroke. It is in these quiet, lung-burning stretches where you realize that the best way to see the terrain is to move through it slowly enough to hear the leaves. There is no engine here, no crowd, and no schedule to keep. Just the sound of your own breath against the forest.
